authorization: User requested more scenes to evaluate C-STMP AER and directly retrain the activity classifier if warranted.

limitations: Colored-trained network queried at C=vI; scalar feedback.
Legacy classifier has not been fine-tuned to the new conditional mean.
Derivative trace is a working variance, not calibrated conditional MSE.

inference_settings: Unchanged C-STMP epoch200, vI, delta .4, native 60..600 stop. No AER/threshold/damping tuning.
baseline_reuse: Frozen STMP .2 and same native stopping; hashes, teacher binding and input identity checked. Timing not compared to concurrent cached runs.
diagnostic: At the terminal C-STMP query, replace only its mean feature by old first mean and evaluate frozen classifier offline. No shadow feedback.

training_trigger.primary: C-STMP has at least 3 additional total detection errors and >=10% more than STMP across assessment cases.
training_trigger.feature_mismatch: At least 3 net terminal errors are repaired by old-mean feature substitution at identical queries, or BCE falls by >=25% with no increase in errors and current detector has errors.
training_trigger.interpretation: Operational trigger for a bounded retraining trial, not a causal or significance claim. If no trigger, retain current classifier and report uncertainty.

conditional_training.noise_model: vI matched to deployed conditional mean
conditional_training.selection: lowest independent fixed-query synthetic validation BCE, including epoch0
conditional_training.deployment: Compare original and adapted classifier on held-out scenes; no automatic replacement based on training loss.

uncertainty: Per-SNR scene-paired bootstrap; shared scene across SNR kept in same resample; diagnostic sample, not 1000-scene definitive evaluation.
